Prior-period High, Low and Close must each be verified by two independent sources before any pivot level is computed, so the daily tier is single-source-indicative on the evidence the report itself shows. Its source-discipline section asserts the 24 Jul full bar is 'two-source corroborated', but that assertion is contradicted by its own evidence table and cannot upgrade the tier. Weekly: the report labels the weekly block single-source-indicative and states it is not used for level-based entries. Monthly: same label, and the block is in any case built on the wrong period. All three toggled tiers are therefore indicative, none can be recomputed from corroborated prior-period H/L/C, and the gate fires. This regeneration may not do new research, so the flag cannot be cleared here. GATE 2 - no breakout side to trade. In a TRANSITION regime the only permitted pivot entry is on the breakout side identified by the momentum-breakout variant; a limit on the counter side is suppressed, not relabelled. Borrowing the trend geometry into a TRANSITION regime is a construction defect even where the levels are internally consistent, and an entry 2.69 pts above the daily pivot and 171 pts inside the envelope is not a breakout.
